ops.prevDaySetup: When the Large Hall or Small Hall is used for preparation or practice, the usage fee is 70% of the regular amount (usage fee revised on April 1, 2026). The hours of use include the work time for setting up and dismantling the event. For the Exhibition Halls, if exhibits and packing materials need to be stored before or after the period of use, apply for facility use for that time (there is no storage warehouse).
ops.loadingHours: The stage-set loading entrance of the Large Hall accepts 11-ton trucks. The loading entrance for the Small Hall, International Conference Room and Meeting Rooms is on the 1st basement floor. The Exhibition Halls are loaded through the dedicated service yard and the loading entrances: Exhibition Hall No.1 is 5.0m wide x 3.2m high, and Exhibition Halls No.2-5 are 4.0m wide x 3.2m high. The service yard holds up to 4 vehicles for Exhibition Halls No.1 and No.5 and up to 2 vehicles for Exhibition Hall No.2. For hand-cart loading and unloading to the Meeting Rooms, use the shared passenger-and-freight / emergency elevators (at both ends of the building, 2nd basement floor to each floor). Meetings must be held up to 2 weeks before the date of use for the halls, Exhibition Halls and Civic Hall, and up to 3 weeks before for the International Conference Room.
ops.vehicleRules: Vehicles for loading to and from the Exhibition Halls must be 3.1m or less in height, 6.8m or less in length and 2.2m or less in width; a "vehicle entry permit" is placed on the vehicle and it must arrive at the designated time (vehicles without a permit or outside the designated time cannot enter). A "service yard entry plan" is submitted so that loading and unloading are staggered, and vehicles that have finished unloading or loading must leave immediately. Parking in the service yard is not allowed. The vehicle limits for loading to the Small Hall, International Conference Room and Meeting Rooms are height 2.9m, width 2.2m and length 6.8m (2026 Guide to Use). The loading dock on the 2nd basement floor for the Meeting Rooms has a height limit of 2.9m.
ops.parking: Paid parking for 140 vehicles (200 yen per 20 minutes, maximum 2,000 yen per 24 hours, height limit 2.3m, 7:00-23:00). There is no parking for mopeds or motorcycles. There is no parking dedicated to organizers, and Exhibition Hall users use the hourly parking (height 2.3m or less). Parking is available for 4 passenger cars for Large Hall users, 2 for the Small Hall and 1 for the International Conference Room.
ops.waitingRooms: The Large Hall has 2 organizer waiting rooms, 10 dressing rooms (2nd floor 92m2, 34m2 and 30m2; 1st floor 17m2, 16m2 and 12m2 x 2; 1st basement floor 81m2, 50m2 and 25m2; all private rooms) and shower rooms. The Small Hall has 1 organizer waiting room and 4 dressing rooms (2nd floor 15m2; 1st floor 30m2, 26m2 and 19m2). The International Conference Room has 2 waiting rooms (secretariat waiting room and reception room) and 2 control rooms.
ops.catering: Food and drink may not be brought in from outside; order food and drink from the designated providers (Lounge Sonic Hall FV Japan Co., Ltd., Palace Hotel Omiya, and Niku no Mansei). FV Japan delivers from 9:15, and the quantity must be confirmed 2 weeks before for 200 meals or more and 1 week before for 100 meals or more. Palace Hotel Omiya takes orders for boxed meals from 20 boxes, up to 1 week before, and for party food from 30 people, up to 8 days before (limited to public rental facilities inside Sonic City). Niku no Mansei takes orders from 15 boxes, up to 7 days before. (Food and drink service page; Palace Hotel Omiya as of February 10, 2026)
